{3}{U}: Target Merfolk can't be blocked this turn.

Brightmare.oracle_text: When this creature enters, tap up to one target creature. You gain life equal to that creature's power.

Faith's Fetters.oracle_text:
Enchant permanent
When this Aura enters, you gain 4 life.
Enchanted permanent can't attack or block, and its activated abilities can't be activated unless they're mana abilities.

Gallant Cavalry.oracle_text:
Vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.)
When this creature enters, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.

Inspiring Overseer.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, you gain 1 life and draw a card.

Merrow Reejerey.oracle_text:
Other Merfolk creatures you control get +1/+1.
Whenever you cast a Merfolk spell, you may tap or untap target permanent.

Naga Vitalist.oracle_text: {T}: Add one mana of any type that a land you control could produce.

Overgrowth.oracle_text:
Enchant land
Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional {G}{G}.

Primeval Herald.oracle_text:
Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

Rambunctious Mutt.oracle_text: When this creature enters, destroy target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.

Soul Read.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Counter target spell unless its controller pays {4}.
• Draw two cards.

Thriving Grove.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than green.
{T}: Add {G} or one mana of the chosen color.

Thriving Heath.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than white.

Towering Gibbon.oracle_text:
Reach

Wispweaver Angel.oracle_text:
Flying

Acrobatic Maneuver.oracle_text:
Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
Draw a card.

Flicker of Fate.oracle_text: Exile target creature or enchantment, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.

Havenwood Wurm.oracle_text:
Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
Trample

Preston, the Vanisher.oracle_text:
Whenever another nontoken creature you control enters, if it wasn't cast, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's a 0/1 white Illusion.

annotations.description: Playing Forest instead of Plains means GPT52 Spike has no white mana source in play. If they miss their next land drop, Naga Vitalist (which produces mana of any type a land could produce) will only make green since only Forests are in play. This delays Gallant Cavalry and reduces flexibility. Playing Plains first ensures white mana access regardless of future draws while still allowing Naga Vitalist to be cast this turn (Forest for G + Plains for generic).
annotations.actionTaken: Played Forest as the second land, leaving no white source on the battlefield.
annotations.betterLine: Play Plains instead. Forest + Plains still lets you cast Naga Vitalist (1G) this turn, and guarantees white mana access for Gallant Cavalry even if you miss a land drop next turn.

annotations.description: Traded away Merrow Reejerey (a Merfolk lord giving +1/+1 to all other Merfolk, plus tap/untap triggers) for a 2/2 Knight token, while at 20 life with Watertrap Weaver and Aquatic Incursion in hand that would have greatly benefited from the lord effect.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked with Merrow Reejerey, trading it for a 2/2 token
annotations.betterLine: Take 4 damage (going to 16), preserve Merrow Reejerey to pump future Merfolk from Aquatic Incursion and Watertrap Weaver. Use Watertrap Weaver next turn to tap down an attacker while getting the +1/+1 buff.

annotations.description: Qwen3L Philo used Merrow Reejerey's tap trigger on Towering Gibbon, which has summoning sickness and can't attack this turn anyway. The Watertrap Weaver's ETB will separately handle tapping a threat (and preventing untap). The Reejerey trigger was wasted on a creature that posed no immediate threat.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted Towering Gibbon with Merrow Reejerey's tap trigger, a creature with summoning sickness that couldn't attack this turn.
annotations.betterLine: Use the Reejerey tap trigger on Gallant Cavalry or the Knight token to reduce the opponent's available attackers this turn, since the Gibbon can't attack regardless of being tapped.

annotations.description: Attacking with Merrow Reejerey into two available 2/2 vigilance blockers risks trading the Merfolk lord, which is the key synergy piece powering Triton Shorestalker (2/2 instead of 1/1) and future Aquatic Incursion tokens (2/2 instead of 1/1). The opponent can profitably trade a Knight token for the lord.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with both Triton Shorestalker and Merrow Reejerey.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with only Triton Shorestalker (unblockable 2 damage guaranteed) and keep Merrow Reejerey back to preserve the +1/+1 lord buff for the Merfolk synergy plan, especially with Aquatic Incursion in hand ready to create two Merfolk tokens next turn.

annotations.description: GPT52 Spike timed out and declared no blockers, taking 4 damage instead of blocking Merrow Reejerey (the Merfolk lord that gives +1/+1 to all other Merfolk) with a 2/2 Knight token or Gallant Cavalry. Trading a token for the Reejerey would be excellent — it removes the lord buff from Triton Shorestalker (reducing it from 2/2 back to 1/1) and eliminates the tap/untap trigger, while only taking 2 unavoidable damage from the unblockable Shorestalker.
annotations.actionTaken: No response (timeout) — no blockers declared, taking full 4 combat damage
annotations.betterLine: Block Merrow Reejerey with the Knight Token (2/2 trades with 2/2), killing the Merfolk lord and reducing future damage from Shorestalker by 1 per turn

annotations.description: GPT52 Spike timed out during precombat main phase with 3 untapped lands and multiple castable spells (Brightmare, Gift of the Gargantuan, Flicker of Fate). The entire turn's mana and development was wasted in a close game (15 vs 16 life).
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and passed priority without casting any spell.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Brightmare targeting Watertrap Weaver to tap it and gain 2 life, adding a 2/3 body to the board. Alternatively, cast Gift of the Gargantuan for card advantage, or Flicker of Fate on Gallant Cavalry to create another 2/2 Knight token.

annotations.description: Timed out on Thriving Grove's color choice. Every card in hand (Brightmare, Flicker of Fate, Preston the Vanisher, Settle Beyond Reality) requires white mana, making White the overwhelmingly correct choice. Timing out risks the game defaulting to a useless color.
annotations.actionTaken: Failed to respond in time, letting the game choose a default color for Thriving Grove.
annotations.betterLine: Choose White immediately, as it's the only color needed by any card in hand.

annotations.description: Used Faith's Fetters (likely on Triton Shorestalker, a 1/1) instead of casting Preston, the Vanisher which has incredible synergy with the rest of the hand (Flicker of Fate, Settle Beyond Reality, Brightmare). Preston as a 2/5 blocks well and creates an engine that generates Illusion token copies whenever a creature is flickered, which the hand is built to exploit. Faith's Fetters is premium removal wasted on a 1/1.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Faith's Fetters (spending all mana on removing a small threat)
annotations.betterLine: Cast Preston, the Vanisher to establish the flicker engine. Preston's 2/5 body blocks effectively, and next turn Flicker of Fate or Brightmare creates Illusion tokens while dealing with threats. Save Faith's Fetters for a larger threat.

annotations.description: Faith's Fetters on a 1/1 Triton Shorestalker is low value when Aquatic Incursion is available as a target. Aquatic Incursion's activated ability ({3}{U}: Target Merfolk can't be blocked) is a more significant threat than 1 damage per turn from the Shorestalker, as it can make any Merfolk (including future ones) unblockable. Faith's Fetters on Aquatic Incursion would both shut down that ability and still gain 4 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted Triton Shorestalker with Faith's Fetters
annotations.betterLine: Target Aquatic Incursion with Faith's Fetters to shut down its unblockable-granting activated ability, which represents more long-term damage potential than the 1/1 Shorestalker.

annotations.description: Double-blocking Towering Gibbon 4/4 (no trample) with both 1/1 Merfolk tokens when a single blocker would have fully absorbed the damage. The second blocker dies for no benefit. The lost Merfolk token had value as a hexproof attacker that could be made unblockable via Aquatic Incursion.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked Towering Gibbon with both Merfolk tokens, losing both.
annotations.betterLine: Block with only one Merfolk token to fully absorb the 4 damage (no trample), preserving the second token as a future attacker/blocker.

annotations.description: Chose Inspiring Overseer (draw a card, 2/1 flyer, 1 life) over Settle Beyond Reality, which could exile the unblockable Triton Shorestalker AND flicker a creature to trigger Preston's Illusion-copying ability. Settle Beyond Reality with both modes would remove a persistent threat and generate additional board presence through Preston.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Inspiring Overseer for a 2/1 flyer, 1 life, and a card draw
annotations.betterLine: Cast Settle Beyond Reality (5 mana available via 4 lands + Naga Vitalist) choosing both modes: exile Triton Shorestalker and flicker a creature like Towering Gibbon to trigger Preston, creating an Illusion token copy. This removes the unblockable threat while building board presence.

annotations.description: At 12 life facing 6 damage from Towering Gibbon (4/4 trample) and Preston (2/5), declining to block with Triton Shorestalker costs 2 life unnecessarily. Going to 6 instead of 8 is significant when the opponent threatens 6+ damage per turn. The Shorestalker's unblockable 1-damage clock is far too slow to race an opponent at 21 life, making it worth sacrificing to preserve life total.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block, taking full 6 damage (to 6 life)
annotations.betterLine: Block Preston, the Vanisher with Triton Shorestalker to save 2 life (going to 8 instead of 6), buying an extra turn of breathing room against the opponent's aggressive board

annotations.description: Opponent is at 6 life with only Triton Shorestalker (1/1) as a non-sick blocker. GPT52 Spike has Brightmare in hand (castable for {2}{W}) which can tap the Shorestalker, removing the only blocker. Then attacking with Inspiring Overseer (2/1 flying), Preston (2/5), Naga Vitalist (1/2), and Towering Gibbon (4/4) deals 9+ unblocked damage against 6 life — lethal. Passing priority in precombat main misses this kill.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in precombat main phase without casting any spells.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Brightmare targeting Triton Shorestalker to tap it, then attack with all creatures for lethal damage (at least 9 damage against 6 life with no available blockers).

annotations.description: At 6 life facing 9 damage (Naga Vitalist 1, Towering Gibbon 4, Preston 2, Inspiring Overseer 2, Overseer token 0), not blocking is lethal. Qwen3L Philo had two available blockers (Primeval Herald 3/1 and Triton Shorestalker 1/1) that could absorb 6 damage by blocking Towering Gibbon and either Preston or the Overseer, surviving at 5 life instead of dying.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to assign any blockers, taking 9 damage at 6 life (lethal).
annotations.betterLine: Block Towering Gibbon (4/4) with Primeval Herald (3/1) and block Inspiring Overseer (2/1) with Triton Shorestalker (1/1), reducing incoming damage to 3 (Naga Vitalist 1 + Preston 2) and surviving at 3 life.
